svg.text: Nucleophilic addition to the carbonyl group (benzaldehyde + HCN)
C=O is polarised Cδ+=Oδ−; the nucleophile attacks carbon, the π pair moves onto oxygen
Reactivity order of carbonyl compounds towards Nu
(steric hindrance and +I of alkyl groups lower the δ+ on C)
decreasing reactivity: aldehydes > ketones; aliphatic > aromatic (resonance with ring reduces δ+ on C)
